title: 747 GP
tagline: Cars, trucks and motorcycles on real-world tracks, now with dirt.
description: Pick Arcade to race a field of up to nine rivals over three laps, or Time Trial to chase your best lap. Choose automatic or manual shifting, one of 12 rides in the showroom, then the track and the size of the grid in race setup. Results show your laps, top speed, finishing order and where you land on the leaderboard.
